content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 6.1 (p0037) imposes exclusive dealing on us — no participation in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products — for the full term, which under Section 4.1 (p0024) is one year auto-renewing on each anniversary, with no automatic exit for HDI non-performance. That is walk-away territory and fails the fallback on duration and performance-based exit.

**Redline (fallback, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace in Section 6.1 changing "during the term of this Agreement" to "for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, ending automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date" — preserving the existing Deerskin Products category scope (already met), the Section 6.2 carve-out, and HDI's own restrictions in Section 6.3, which benefit us and were not touched.
